title: Sharon AI signs five-year Rafay Systems orchestration agreement
ai_summary: Sharon AI signed a five-year agreement to use Rafay Systems as a centralised orchestration layer for its AI Factory environments. The platform will standardise provisioning, governance, and monitoring, supporting up to 150,000 GPUs over the term. The deal follows recent $373m and $1.32bn cloud computing contracts.

title: Sharon AI Partners with Rafay Systems for Scalable AI Infrastructure Management
ai_summary: Sharon AI Holdings and Rafay Systems signed a five-year partnership to use Rafay's orchestration platform for Sharon AI's AI Factory environments. The agreement aims to standardize provisioning, governance, and monitoring across locations, supporting expansion in Asia-Pacific. The architecture is designed to orchestrate up to 150,000 GPUs over the term.

title: Rafay Systems Receives NVIDIA-Certified Hypervisors Accreditation for AI Infrastructure
ai_summary: Rafay Systems announced that its Virtual Machines-as-a-Service offering has been certified by NVIDIA under the NVIDIA-Certified Hypervisors program, covering HGX systems and NVL72 rack-scale infrastructure. CEO Haseeb Budhani said the certification validates the platform's governance and multi-tenancy capabilities for AI workloads. Rafay is a member of NVIDIA Inception.

title: MiTAC Computing Showcases Diversified Infra for Agentic Workloads at OCP APAC Summit
ai_summary: MiTAC Computing showcased its diversified rack-scale infrastructure for Agentic AI workloads at the OCP APAC Summit in Taipei, premiering new OCP-compliant HPC servers developed in collaboration with AMD. The company introduced the C2810Z6 and C2610Z6 compute platforms powered by 6th Gen AMD EPYC CPUs, alongside comprehensive liquid-cooled rack solutions designed to support high-density GPU clusters and multi-agent reasoning loops. MiTAC also highlighted partnerships with DDN, Rafay, and Canonical to provide a full-stack 'AI Factory' ecosystem integrating storage, governance, and orchestration.

title: Exclusive: Upwind adds context scanning for AI agents as AI DR hits general availability
ai_summary: Protopia AI Inc. and Rafay Systems Inc. announced a partnership to combine multi-tenant token delivery with upstream data protection for enterprise AI infrastructure, enabling providers to monetize shared GPU capacity while keeping enterprise context private.

title: Aolani & Rafay deploy NVIDIA DSX OS on GB200 NVL72
ai_summary: Aolani and Rafay have deployed NVIDIA DSX OS on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 infrastructure in what they describe as among the first implementations of its kind in the industry. The collaboration combines Aolani's AI cloud infrastructure with Rafay's software for orchestration, automation, multi-tenancy and lifecycle management, enabling customers to provision Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines, AI workspaces and inference environments through a self-service model with central governance and policy enforcement. The companies position this as an example of how AI infrastructure operators can shift from simply installing GPU systems to offering governed, production-ready AI platforms that customers can use from day one.

title: Aolani and Rafay Collaborate on One of the Industry’s First NVIDIA DSX OS Deployments on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 Infrastructure
ai_summary: Aolani and Rafay Systems announced a strategic collaboration to deploy one of the industry's first instances of NVIDIA DSX OS running on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 infrastructure, combining Aolani's AI cloud infrastructure with Rafay Platform's orchestration, automation, multi-tenancy, and lifecycle management capabilities. The solution enables organizations to provision Kubernetes clusters, virtual machines, AI workspaces, and inference environments through a secure self-service experience while maintaining centralized governance, policy enforcement, and operational visibility. The collaboration addresses the challenge of transforming next-generation GPU infrastructure into governed, production-ready AI platforms without requiring organizations to build the operational software stack themselves.

title: Aolani and Rafay's Groundbreaking Partnership for AI Infrastructure
ai_summary: Aolani and Rafay Systems have announced a strategic partnership to accelerate AI infrastructure deployment by combining Aolani's AI cloud solutions with Rafay's orchestration and automation platform. The collaboration represents one of the early deployments of NVIDIA DSX OS operating on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 infrastructure, enabling organizations to move AI technology from installation phases directly into production-ready services. The companies aim to help enterprises and cloud providers manage multi-tenant environments more efficiently while developers gain immediate access to environments for AI model development, training, and inference.
